maria (FinOps): Quick flag: Orchid Health renewal invoice INV-2026-045 billed full platform fee for 2026 but contract amendment shows private deployment effective 2026-07-01. Need corrected invoice before renewal notice next Mon.
raj (Billing): Can you paste invoice lines?
maria (FinOps): From PDF:
INV-2026-045
Line: Private Deployment - Platform Fee - Period 01Jan2026-31Dec2026 - $120,000
Migration proration credit - $0
Support Tier Platinum - Period 01Jul2026-30Jun2027 - $36,000
maria (FinOps): Contract RDW-ORCH-2024-A, Amendment AMEND-17 signed 2026-06-22 (link in contract system).
olivia (CS): Confirmed — CS & Sales agreed to pro-rate platform fee for mid-year private migration. Customer expects corrected invoice.
sven (Sales): Sales ops opened SO-1129. I thought billing pipeline would auto-apply amendment.
raj (Billing): Reproduced locally: proration job skipped amendment created 23:58 UTC due to boundary bug. Creating billing-engine ticket.
billing-bot: Created BE-4983 "proration job skips amendments created in final minute of day" assigned billing-engine-team.
maria (FinOps): Orchid needs corrected invoice + credit memo now. Can billing issue manual correction?
raj (Billing): Yes. Pro-rate calc: $120k * 6/12 = $60k => credit $60k. Will draft credit memo + corrected invoice, attach AMEND-17 + SO-1129, route for sign-off. ETA draft EOD, final tomorrow morning.
olivia (CS): I'll notify customer this is an internal correction and share corrected invoice when available.
sven (Sales): I approve a one-off credit up to $75k for the account.
maria (FinOps): Filed approval AR-6521. Raj please include amendment PDF, SO-1129, and an auditor-friendly note with the pro-rate calc in the memo.
raj (Billing): Will include those. Also logging BE-4983 for permanent fix and backfill.
billing-bot: BE-4983 updated: fix deployed to staging; backfill scheduled.
maria (FinOps): After credit posts, finance will do revenue reversal and update renewal docs. Ping when BE-4983 backfill completes so we can reconcile automated billing runs.
raj (Billing): Will follow up and close the loop. Credit memo will reference AMEND-17 and show calculation 120000 * 6/12 = 60000.
olivia (CS): I'll prepare the customer-facing note and hold renewal email until corrected invoice is attached.
maria (FinOps): Thanks all. Task closed once invoice corrected and AR updated.
